technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, implement the info command by adding a new subcommand to the existing xd-yarn shell script, querying Zookeeper for admin port.
For U2, follow the existing plugin pattern for Spark and RxJava, creating a reactor processor module that allows specifying the processor class and additional configuration via module options.
For U3, add a history tracking option that enriches message headers with stream name and module name, integrated into the message processing pipeline.

For U7 and U8, implement validation logic for mutually exclusive sql and tableName options in partitioned jobs, and document the behavior.
Integration testing will be performed to ensure all features work together without conflicts.
assumptions: All development is done by a single developer with expertise in Java, Spring, and the Spring XD codebase.

Required third-party libraries (Protocol Buffers, Ambari SDK) are available and compatible with the project's version.
No major architectural changes are required; features are additive and follow existing patterns.

activities.activity_name: Implement info command in xd-yarn script
activities.activity_description: Add a new info subcommand to the xd-yarn shell script that retrieves the admin port (e.g., from Zookeeper) for the current deployment, providing a convenient way for users to get deployment info.
Create a plugin that allows a reactor processor module to specify the processor class and additional configuration via well-known module options, similar to existing Spark and RxJava plugins.

activities.activity_name: Add history tracking option to message headers
activities.activity_description: Implement an option to track history by adding stream name and module name to message headers, giving users visibility into data flow.
Add a codec option for Google Protocol Buffers, enabling serialization/deserialization of objects based on protobuf native specifications.

activities.activity_name: Add test coverage for complex objects
activities.activity_description: Write test cases for complex objects such as protocol buffers, objects with nested variables, and trees to evaluate and document performance characteristics.

activities.activity_name: Develop Ambari plugin for Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Create an Ambari plugin to provision, manage, and monitor Spring XD clusters using the same tool used for Hadoop clusters.

Update the wiki to clearly document that tableName and columns are explicitly required for partitioned jobs, and that sql and tableName options are mutually exclusive. Include the logic from JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata.

activities.activity_name: Implement sql/tableName options for partitioned jobs
activities.activity_description: Modify the partitioned job definition to support either sql or tableName options, ensuring mutual exclusivity and proper validation.
Perform integration testing across all features to identify and fix any issues, ensuring cohesive functionality of the software increment.
Update user guides, API docs, and any relevant documentation to reflect the new features and changes introduced in this increment.
